keyPoints.en: Refraction: light changes direction because its speed changes when entering a different medium.
keyPoints.bm: Pembiasan: cahaya berubah arah kerana lajunya berubah apabila memasuki medium berbeza.

keyPoints.en: Air → glass/water: light slows down and bends towards the normal. Glass → air: bends away.
keyPoints.bm: Udara → kaca/air: cahaya menjadi perlahan dan membias ke arah normal. Kaca → udara: membias menjauhi normal.

keyPoints.en: Refractive index n = sin i / sin r = c/v (always ≥ 1). Water ≈ 1.33, glass ≈ 1.5.
keyPoints.bm: Indeks biasan n = sin i / sin r = c/v (sentiasa ≥ 1). Air ≈ 1.33, kaca ≈ 1.5.

keyPoints.en: Real and apparent depth: n = real depth ÷ apparent depth — water looks shallower than it is.
keyPoints.bm: Dalam nyata dan ketara: n = dalam nyata ÷ dalam ketara — air kelihatan lebih cetek.

question.en: Light travels at 2 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ in a glass block. Find n.
question.bm: Cahaya bergerak pada 2 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ dalam blok kaca. Cari n.

tip.en: Angles are always measured from the NORMAL, not the surface.
tip.bm: Sudut sentiasa diukur dari NORMAL, bukan permukaan.

keyPoints.en: Critical angle c: the angle of incidence (in the denser medium) for which the angle of refraction is 90°. sin c = 1/n.
keyPoints.bm: Sudut genting c: sudut tuju (dalam medium tumpat) yang menghasilkan sudut biasan 90°. sin c = 1/n.

keyPoints.en: Total internal reflection needs: (1) dense → less dense medium, (2) i > c.
keyPoints.bm: Pantulan dalam penuh memerlukan: (1) tumpat → kurang tumpat, (2) i > c.

keyPoints.en: Optical fibres carry internet and endoscope images using repeated total internal reflection.
keyPoints.bm: Gentian optik membawa internet dan imej endoskop menggunakan pantulan dalam penuh berulang.

keyPoints.en: Mirages on a hot road and the sparkle of diamonds (c ≈ 24°) are also due to total internal reflection.
keyPoints.bm: Logamaya di jalan panas dan kilauan berlian (c ≈ 24°) juga disebabkan pantulan dalam penuh.

question.en: Water has n = 1.33. Find its critical angle.
question.bm: Air mempunyai n = 1.33. Cari sudut gentingnya.

tip.en: Higher n → smaller critical angle → total internal reflection happens more easily.
tip.bm: n lebih tinggi → sudut genting lebih kecil → pantulan dalam penuh lebih mudah berlaku.

keyPoints.en: Convex (converging) lens: thicker in the middle, focuses parallel rays to a real focus F.
keyPoints.bm: Kanta cembung (penumpu): tebal di tengah, menumpukan sinar selari ke fokus nyata F.

keyPoints.en: Concave (diverging) lens: thinner in the middle, spreads rays as if from a virtual focus.
keyPoints.bm: Kanta cekung (pencapah): nipis di tengah, mencapahkan sinar seolah-olah dari fokus maya.

keyPoints.en: Three key rays: parallel → through F; through optical centre → straight; through F → parallel.
keyPoints.bm: Tiga sinar utama: selari → melalui F; melalui pusat optik → lurus; melalui F → selari.

keyPoints.en: Convex lens images depend on object distance: beyond 2F (camera), F–2F (projector), inside F (magnifier).
keyPoints.bm: Imej kanta cembung bergantung pada jarak objek: melebihi 2F (kamera), F–2F (projektor), di dalam F (kanta pembesar).

question.en: Where should a slide be placed in a projector?
question.bm: Di manakah slaid perlu diletakkan dalam projektor?

answer.en: Between F and 2F, upside down, so the image on the screen is real, magnified and the right way up.
answer.bm: Antara F dan 2F, terbalik, supaya imej pada skrin nyata, dibesarkan dan tegak.

tip.en: Draw ray diagrams with a ruler; two rays are enough to locate an image.
tip.bm: Lukis rajah sinar dengan pembaris; dua sinar sudah cukup untuk menentukan imej.

keyPoints.en: Thin lens formula: 1/f = 1/u + 1/v.
keyPoints.bm: Formula kanta nipis: 1/f = 1/u + 1/v.

keyPoints.en: Sign convention: convex f positive, concave f negative; real image v positive, virtual image v negative.
keyPoints.bm: Konvensyen tanda: cembung f positif, cekung f negatif; imej nyata v positif, imej maya v negatif.

keyPoints.en: Linear magnification m = v/u = image height ÷ object height.
keyPoints.bm: Pembesaran linear m = v/u = tinggi imej ÷ tinggi objek.

keyPoints.en: Power P = 1/f (f in metres), unit dioptre (D). Convex lens: positive power.
keyPoints.bm: Kuasa P = 1/f (f dalam meter), unit diopter (D). Kanta cembung: kuasa positif.

question.en: An object is 10 cm from a concave lens of f = −15 cm. Find v.
question.bm: Objek 10 cm dari kanta cekung f = −15 cm. Cari v.

tip.en: A negative v means a virtual image — don't drop the sign!
tip.bm: v negatif bermakna imej maya — jangan buang tanda!

keyPoints.en: Magnifying glass: one convex lens, object inside F → virtual, upright, magnified image.
keyPoints.bm: Kanta pembesar: satu kanta cembung, objek di dalam F → imej maya, tegak, dibesarkan.

keyPoints.en: Compound microscope: objective lens (short f) makes a real magnified image; eyepiece magnifies it again.
keyPoints.bm: Mikroskop majmuk: kanta objek (f pendek) membentuk imej nyata dibesarkan; kanta mata membesarkannya lagi.

keyPoints.en: Astronomical telescope: objective (long f) + eyepiece (short f); normal adjustment length = f_o + f_e, M = f_o/f_e.
keyPoints.bm: Teleskop astronomi: kanta objek (f panjang) + kanta mata (f pendek); panjang pelarasan normal = f_o + f_e, M = f_o/f_e.

keyPoints.en: Phone cameras use tiny lenses with very short focal lengths so the camera can be thin.
keyPoints.bm: Kamera telefon menggunakan kanta kecil berpanjang fokus sangat pendek supaya kamera nipis.

question.en: Which lens should be the objective of a telescope: f = 5 cm or f = 80 cm?
question.bm: Kanta manakah sesuai sebagai kanta objek teleskop: f = 5 cm atau f = 80 cm?

answer.en: f = 80 cm (objective has the longer focal length); M = 80/5 = 16
answer.bm: f = 80 cm (kanta objek f lebih panjang); M = 80/5 = 16

tip.en: Microscope objective: SHORT f. Telescope objective: LONG f.
tip.bm: Kanta objek mikroskop: f PENDEK. Kanta objek teleskop: f PANJANG.

keyPoints.en: Concave mirror: curves inwards, converges light, real focus F at half the radius of curvature (f = r/2).
keyPoints.bm: Cermin cekung: melengkung ke dalam, menumpukan cahaya, fokus nyata F pada separuh jejari kelengkungan (f = r/2).

keyPoints.en: Convex mirror: curves outwards, diverges light; images are always virtual, upright and diminished.
keyPoints.bm: Cermin cembung: melengkung ke luar, mencapahkan cahaya; imej sentiasa maya, tegak dan dikecilkan.

keyPoints.en: Concave mirror uses: make-up/dentist mirrors (object inside F), torch/headlamp reflectors (bulb at F), solar cookers.
keyPoints.bm: Kegunaan cermin cekung: cermin solek/doktor gigi (objek di dalam F), pemantul lampu suluh/kereta (mentol di F), pemasak solar.

keyPoints.en: Convex mirror uses: car side mirrors, shop security mirrors, sharp road bends.
keyPoints.bm: Kegunaan cermin cembung: cermin sisi kereta, cermin keselamatan kedai, selekoh tajam.

question.en: Why is the bulb in a torch placed at the focus of a concave mirror?
question.bm: Mengapa mentol dalam lampu suluh diletakkan di fokus cermin cekung?

answer.en: Light from F reflects as a strong parallel beam.
answer.bm: Cahaya dari F dipantulkan sebagai alur selari yang kuat.

tip.en: Mirror ray rules mirror the lens rules — but light reflects back instead of passing through.
tip.bm: Peraturan sinar cermin serupa dengan kanta — tetapi cahaya dipantulkan balik, bukan menembusi.
